warnings.quote: The extension projects 3.9 m beyond the original rear wall
warnings.span_text: The extension projects 3.9 m beyond the original rear wall.

reasons.text: The 3.9 m projection is within the 4.0 m limit for terraced houses.
The first-floor side window facing No. 18 at 6 m must be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 m.
The footings are outside the ash tree's root protection area.

conditions.text: The first-floor side window facing No. 18 shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 m above floor level, and retained so.
No footings shall be placed within 5.2 m of ash tree T1.

citations.quote: The extension projects 3.9 m beyond the original rear wall
Rear extensions on terraced dwellings should not project more than 4.0 m beyond the original
First-floor side windows facing a neighbour within 10 m must be obscure-glazed and non-opening
Footings at 6.5 m are outside the root protection area.

conflicts: NBR-2 measures the projection at 4.3 m (NBR-2@1:p1:1); the DAS states 3.9 m (DAS@1:p1:1).
gaps: No measured survey settles whether the projection is 3.9 m or 4.3 m.
The drainage route to the public sewer is not shown.
